definitions.decode_variance_unsupplied_retained: the two CONCORDANT matching cells restricted to RETAINED trajectories -- handed NO evidence at all; the BLEND arm answered with its own contact-0 direct decode, so any movement here is decode variance between two separate runs and cannot be a supply effect
definitions.matching_attributable: the two DISCORDANT matching cells; identical to the landed document's (a) term
definitions.supply_attributable_dispatched: the two CONCORDANT matching cells restricted to DISPATCHED trajectories -- the ONLY place where evidence actually reached the core with matching status held fixed, and therefore the only place a supply effect on extraction can appear

three_way_decomposition_matching.double_conditioning_caveat: cell membership is a function of the arms' matching OUTCOMES **and** of a POST-TREATMENT branch decision (the dispatch decision is itself an outcome of the controller acting on the trajectory), so every conditioned number here carries selection (collider) bias TWICE OVER. These are DESCRIPTIVE MECHANISM READINGS, NEVER EFFECT SIZES, and a small-n cell is a mechanism reading whatever its interval says. Both rules were fixed in the ledger row before any n was known.
three_way_decomposition_matching.refines_the_landed_split: the landed (b) 'matching-independent' term is EXACTLY the sum of the last two terms here, so this decomposition refines the landed one rather than contradicting it

unexposed500.exposure_label: SECONDARY READING on the LOCKED baseline's unexposed-500 population. The already-landed aggregates were computed inside the one-shot lock read; these CONDITIONED statistics are a secondary reading and MUST NOT be used to revise, re-tune or restate the LOCK.
unexposed500.override_caveat: the FLOWN BLEND arm is the v2 policy, whose delta retain-override can dispatch a trajectory whose direct label WAS recovered. The LOCKED v1 cell would have RETAINED those override fires. This module takes the branch AS THE CONTROLLER ACTUALLY DECIDED IT (contacts == 2), because the sealed answers being scored are the flown v2 answers; the three-way split (retain_primary / dead_direct_dispatch / override_dispatch) is published so the v1 reading can be recovered from the same table.
